name: onboarding
role: the owner of a small project on your own computer; nobody else has set anything up for you
goal: I want an assistant in my terminal that can help me with this project.
note: First walk of dun (2026-10-23). Arrival: dun is installed and has never been run; the project folder is yours, with its history; you start dun inside it.

steps.promise: The first screen tells me what dun needs from me before it can help.
If I ask before it is set up, it tells me what to do next, in words I can follow.

actions.type: Can you help me with this project?

steps.promise: I can find the command that connects dun to the service my colleague gave me.
Signing in asks for one thing at a time, and says what each thing is.

actions.wait_for: log in to an AI service

steps.promise: Once I have signed in with what my colleague gave me, I am shown the models I can use.

actions.say: typed the address my colleague gave me
typed the key my colleague gave me

steps.promise: Picking the model my colleague named leaves me ready to ask, and tells me it worked.
The question I asked before I was set up is still there, and I get an answer I can read.

actions.say: pressed Enter (the input line held my first question)

steps.promise: Adding the notes server my colleague mentioned asks only for what they gave me.
dun tells me the notes server is added and working.
I ask about the team notes and get an answer that came from them.

actions.type: What do the team notes say?
